items.context: She was remarkably resilient in the face of one setback after another.
It took me a while to get the hang of it.

items.text: It took me a while to get the hang of it.

When I first moved abroad, everything felt like a puzzle. Ordering coffee, reading a timetable, even saying hello had a rhythm I could not hear yet. It took me a while to get the hang of it, but once I stopped translating in my head, the city started to make sense.
questions: 作者一开始为什么觉得一切像谜题？
